ORDINANCE February 1, 2025

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 15-I in the area bounded by

The alley parallel to and north of Lincoln Avenue; a line 118.20 feet from Fairfield Avenue; Lincoln
Avenue; a line 43.20 feet from Fairfield Avenue.

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 5689-93 North Lincoln Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60659
